description:
Bookkeeping/process finding from review: Beadwork still shows parent epics for completed connector waves as open/ready even though their leaf tasks are closed. Examples include Cal.com, HubSpot, Airtable, Generic Webhook, Jira, Linear, PostHog, Calendly, and Salesforce. This makes `bw ready` misleading: it shows epics as ready even when there are no remaining leaf implementation tasks.

Why this matters: the Pi factory deliberately avoids epics by default, but humans looking at `bw ready` can interpret open parent epics as unfinished implementation work. Closing parent epics should happen only after the review/hardening tasks and verification command pass, not immediately after the last leaf task.

Acceptance:
- After REVIEW-S01 through REVIEW-S07 are done, audit the Wave 4-6 parent epics and close only those whose child tasks are closed and whose package verification passes.
- Leave Generic HTTP deferred; do not close it as completed.
- Confirm `bw ready` no longer implies there are unfinished connector implementation epics from the completed wave.
- Add comments to any parent epic left open explaining why it remains open.
title: [REVIEW-S08] Finalize completed connector parent epics
